feeds.description: QuinnCreative's mission is writing, training, coaching all using creative approaches, laughter, and story-telling to help businesses and individuals discover their hidden strengths and share them. Follow Quinn Creative blog written by Quinn McDonald to learn how to focus on the reader and tell a story the reader cares about.

feeds.title: Be a Freelance Blogger
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Sophie Lizard. I started freelance writing online in 2009 when I was broke, jobless, homeless and pregnant. In my blog You'll find out where the best jobs are hiding, how to negotiate with clients, how to set your rates, and what makes a successful freelance blogging career. I'll teach you everything I've learned in several years of freelance blogging, so you won't have to waste time making rookie mistakes or wondering how to get ahead.

feeds.title: Authority Self-Publishing Blog
feeds.description: Teaches other authors how to create a sustainable business around their books. Learn from Bestselling authors how to research, fearlessly write and successfully launch your book.

feeds.title: The Book Designer
feeds.description: Joel Friedlander, the creator of the site, used his background in book design, advertising, and graphic design to create a collection of over 700 articles that are authoritative, easy to understand, and fair-minded. The information here has helped guide thousands of authors just like you as they made their way through the publishing process.

feeds.title: Jerry Jenkins Blog
feeds.description: 21-time New York Times bestselling author Jerry Jenkins reveals the secrets to compelling fiction and nonfiction writing.

feeds.title: LittleZotz Writing Blog
feeds.description: Writing for Businesses. Advice for Writers. LittleZotz Writing provides writing that is not only high-quality but brightens readers days with just a touch of humor. Or so I'm told.

feeds.title: Novel Publicity Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2011, Novel Publicity provides marketing, editing, and design services for all authors, regardless of their paths to publication. We believe that every story deserves to be told, and every story deserves its very own base of readers who will love and cherish it for years to come. Connecting authors with the perfect audiences for their books is what we do best.

feeds.title: Indies Unlimited
feeds.description: It is the mission of Indies Unlimited to celebrate independent authors; to help them build their followings; to provide a platform for members of the independent author community to share and exchange ideas, knowledge, expertise and frustrations; and, for readers and reviewers to become exposed to the amazing depth and array of talent in the indie community.

feeds.title: How to Plan, Write, and Develop a Book
feeds.description: Create, Craft, and Sell Your First Novel, Memoir or Nonfiction Book. Tips from Award-Winning Author Mary Carroll Moore

feeds.title: Seekerville
feeds.description: It all began when 15 contest-winning inspirational author divas began to meet in person at the September 2004 ACFW conference in Denver, Colorado. By 2011, we had accomplished our goal. And in ten years of blogging here in Seekerville, we've helped a lot of people achieve the same goals, no cost, no fees. Just good old-fashioned advice from people who walk the walk.

feeds.title: Will Write For Food
feeds.description: Award-winning author of Will Write for Food. Coach. Editor. Teacher. Speaker. Blogger. Dianne Jacob, a multiple award-winning writer and editor who will coach you to success on your next writing project.

feeds.title: NowNovel
feeds.description: Now Novel's novel writing blog, packed with helpful how to's, writing tips, and guides for writing books.

feeds.title: The Novelry Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Novelry, the world's specialist fiction writing school, with a range of exciting courses created by a Booker-listed author. We offer something unique: one-to-one coaching with bestselling authors and editors from major publishers, as well as live writing classes and events every week.

feeds.title: Meta/ Phor(e) /Play
feeds.description: I write, edit, publish, make art, & teach. Research film-docs. DM for readings, workshops, or other gigs. US ex-pat leftist in Israel.

feeds.title: The Top Author Blog
feeds.description: At The Top-Author, we hold a deep appreciation for the diverse tapestry of creativity woven by artists across all genres. This platform is dedicated to celebrating the richness of literature where the vibrant stories of authors come to life. Behind every compelling piece of writing lies an author's unique journey, motivations, and unwavering dedication to their craft. Our commitment is to showcase not only the final masterpiece but also the intricate threads that compose the fabric of an author's creative odyssey.

feeds.title: The Poesie of Igor Goldkind
feeds.description: The Stories, Accounts and Adventures of Igor Goldkind, Poet, Author, Techno Trouble Maker, regarding the binary language of images. The computational narrative, neuro-phenomenology, mindful computation and the tales our data will tell us once we slow down and listen to their hum.

feeds.title: Kiran Manral
feeds.description: Kiran Manral is an award winning Indian author, TEDx Speaker, columnist, mentor and feminist. She has written books across genres in both fiction and nonfiction. Her books include The Reluctant Detective, Once Upon A Crush, All Aboard, Karmic Kids, A Boy's Guide to Growing Up, The Face at the Window and Saving Maya. She has authored a short series called True Love Stories for Juggernaut.

feeds.title: Writer's Digest
feeds.description: Writer's Digest is the No. 1 resource for writing better and getting published. Writer's Digest seeks to inspire and inform writers, and help them succeed in all their publishing endeavors.

feeds.title: Writer's Relief Blog
feeds.description: Writer's Relief (est. 1994) is an author's submission service; we help writers make targeted, professional submissions to literary agents & editors.

feeds.title: Kathryn Lane Blog
feeds.description: Kathryn Lane, award-winning author of the Nikki Garcia Thriller series, sets her novels in foreign countries and her short stories in exotic places. Kathryn credits her imagination to growing up in Mexico, a country which was rich in storytelling and steeped in cultural traditions. Her creativity was first expressed by painting in oils and when reality of earning a living set in, she studied accounting and finance, and joined a multinational corporation where she obtained her dream job of traveling abroad.

feeds.title: ProWritingAid Blog
feeds.description: Essential tips and techniques for writers. Strengthen your writing and get published sooner! Your personal writing coach. A grammar checker, style editor, and writing mentor in one package. The best writing depends on much more than just correct grammar. You need an editing tool that also highlights style issues and compares your writing to the best writers in your genre.

feeds.title: Write with Fey
feeds.description: I started Write with Fey in 2012 to help aspiring writers like me in need of inspiration and advice. Along with author interviews I also do blogger interviews, which is something you won't see anywhere else. You can find tips on how to write a novel from beginning to end here: How to Write a Novel. If you search my blog you will also find advice on how to write specific events (and characters) such as kidnappings, tor

feeds.title: TRUTH: In 1000 Words or Less Blog
feeds.description: In 1000 Words or Less is the award-winning writings of Steven A. Craig. Humorous and insightful, they are 'a collection of searingly honest takes on the ills that plague modern America by one of today's most important voices'.
